preconditions.expression: n == len(s) and isinstance(n, int) and n >= 1 and n <= 2000 and isinstance(s, str) and all(c.islower() for c in s)
preconditions.description: Input consists of a positive integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2000) and a lowercase string s of length n.

postconditions.description: The output is the original word that, when encoded by repeatedly extracting the median letter (left-middle for even lengths) and appending it to the result, produces the input string s.

postconditions.expression: all(len(word) == i + 1 and word == s[:i+1] for i in range(len(s)) if (i == 0 or (i > 0 and s[i] == decode_encoding(s)[(i + (i + 1) // 2) - 1])))
postconditions.description: For each step i in the encoding process, the i-th character of the output word is the median letter of the remaining word at step i, and the encoding process reconstructs s by appending these medians in order.
